Continue the intensive Figma-fidelity re-audit. Three real rendering defects were just found and fixed in product-item/item-variant (commits 07d557da, 563d376d, a37ec138). This task is research/verification, not a rendering-measurement task like the other parallel forks running right now — you're resolving two specific open questions by reading real sources carefully, not by guessing or inferring.

**Question 1 — is the desktop price position a real gap or a disclosed decision?** `overrides/app/components/item-variant/item-price.tsx`, rendered from `product-item/index.tsx`: on desktop, the price renders far from the product name, positioned next to the quantity stepper/Remove action instead (confirmed via live measurement: desktop price sits at roughly the same x/y as the Remove button, not beneath the name). Figma's own structure (`.runs/SFCC-11/figma-reference/default-page-template.md`) groups name+price together in one "Item Info" block with a 16px gap, entirely separate from where the stepper sits. Read `.claude/session-notes.md` (all of §11, especially §11.2 and anywhere else product-item/item-variant layout is discussed) and `.runs/zimmerMANN-skills/.runs/SFCC-11/plan.md` (steps 2.2, B2 file manifest, B3) in full detail — search specifically for any discussion of price position, "PricePerItem", desktop vs mobile price placement, or a base-SFCC layout being intentionally kept. Also read the actual base (unmodified) SFCC file this was copy-first ported from: `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/product-item/index.jsx` — does the BASE template already position price next to the quantity control on desktop, before any Zimmermann styling touched it? If so, this may be an inherited base-layout skeleton that commit 5's restyle recoloured without ever being asked to rearrange — state plainly whether you find explicit evidence either way, and don't invent a conclusion the sources don't support. This question will go to Marcel either way; your job is to arm that conversation with facts, not to resolve it yourself.

**Question 2 — does the real cart path ever reach `item-attributes.tsx`'s un-restyled `<Text>` branches?** `overrides/app/components/item-variant/item-attributes.tsx` has one branch using the correctly-restyled `styles.colourSize` (already confirmed correct, Figma's colour+size combined string) — but also many other `<Text fontSize="sm" color="gray.700">`-style blocks using generic, non-Zimmermann Chakra colours/sizes, apparently for a `combineAttributeValues=false` per-key path and other special cases (promo, gift messages). Read the full file, then trace: does `product-item/index.tsx` (the real cart row) ever call `<CartItemVariantAttributes>` with `combineAttributeValues` unset or false for any code path reachable from the actual cart? Or is `combineAttributeValues` always explicitly `true` wherever the cart renders it (grep confirmed one call site at product-item/index.tsx passing `combineAttributeValues` — check if there's a prop default and whether any other real caller in this build passes it differently)? If the per-key/other branches are genuinely unreachable from anything SFCC-11 built, this is the same "dead code for our purposes" shape as `product-quantity-picker.tsx` in commit 11 — state that conclusion only if the trace actually supports it, with the exact call sites cited. If it IS reachable from a real path, that's a live gap worth flagging precisely (which branch, what it currently renders with unstyled tokens, what real Figma value it should be using instead — check `.runs/SFCC-11/figma-reference/` for anything covering a per-key attribute display, and say plainly if nothing does).

Report back in text with a clear verdict on each question — CONFIRMED (fully traced, sources checked) or genuinely unresolved (say exactly what's missing) — and the specific file/line citations backing each. Don't pad with restated background; get straight to what you found.

import React from 'react'
import PropTypes from 'prop-types'

// Chakra Components
import {Box, Fade, Flex, Stack, Text} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/shared/ui'

// Project Components
import {HideOnDesktop, HideOnMobile} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/responsive'

import CartItemVariantPrice from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/item-variant/item-price'
import LoadingSpinner from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/loading-spinner'
import BonusProductQuantity from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/product-item/bonus-product-quantity'
import ProductQuantityPicker from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/product-item/product-quantity-picker'

// Utilities
import {noop} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/utils'

// Hooks
import {useCurrency, useDerivedProduct} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks'

/**
 * Component representing a product item usually in a list with details about the product - name, variant, pricing, etc.
 * @param {Object} product Product to be represented in the list item.
 * @param {node} primaryAction Child component representing the most prominent action to be performed by the user.
 * @param {node} secondaryActions Child component representing the other actions relevant to the product to be performed by the user.
 * @param {node} deliveryActions Child component representing the delivery actions relevant to the product to be performed by the user.
 * @param {func} onItemQuantityChange callback function to be invoked whenever item quantity changes.
 * @param {boolean} showLoading Renders a loading spinner with overlay if set to true.
 * @returns A JSX element representing product item in a list (eg: wishlist, cart, etc).
 */
const ProductItem = ({
    product,
    primaryAction,
    secondaryActions,
    deliveryActions,
    onItemQuantityChange = noop,
    showLoading = false,
    containerStyles = {},
    isRemoving = false,
    pickupInStore = false
}) => {
    const {stepQuantity, showInventoryMessage, inventoryMessage, quantity, setQuantity} =
        useDerivedProduct(product, false, false, pickupInStore)
    const {currency: activeCurrency} = useCurrency()
    return (
        <Box
            position="relative"
            data-testid={`sf-cart-item-${product.productId ? product.productId : product.id}`}
        >

                                                align="left"

                                            />
                                        </Box>
                                    </HideOnDesktop>
                                </Stack>
                                {deliveryActions && !product.bonusProductLineItem && (
                                    <HideOnMobile>{deliveryActions}</HideOnMobile>
                                )}
                            </Flex>

                            {deliveryActions && !product.bonusProductLineItem && (
                                <HideOnDesktop>{deliveryActions}</HideOnDesktop>
                            )}

                            <Flex align="flex-end" justify="space-between">
                                <Stack spacing={1}>
                                    {!(isRemoving && product.bonusProductLineItem) &&
                                        (product.bonusProductLineItem ? (
                                            <BonusProductQuantity product={product} />
                                        ) : (
                                            <ProductQuantityPicker
                                                product={product}
                                                onItemQuantityChange={onItemQuantityChange}
                                                stepQuantity={stepQuantity}
                                                quantity={quantity}
                                                setQuantity={setQuantity}
                                            />
                                        ))}
                                </Stack>
                                <Stack>
                                    <HideOnMobile>
                                        <CartItemVariantPrice currency={activeCurrency} />
                                    </HideOnMobile>
                                    <Box display={['none', 'block', 'block', 'block']}>
                                        {primaryAction}
                                    </Box>
                                </Stack>
                            </Flex>

                            <Box>
                                {product && showInventoryMessage && (
                                    <Fade in={true}>
                                        <Text color="orange.600" fontWeight={600}>
                                            {inventoryMessage}
                                        </Text>
                                    </Fade>
                                )}
                            </Box>

                            {secondaryActions}
                        </Stack>
                    </Flex>

                    <Box display={['block', 'none', 'none', 'none']} w={'full'}>
                        {primaryAction}
                    </Box>
                </Stack>
            </ItemVariantProvider>
        </Box>
    )
}

ProductItem.propTypes = {
    product: PropTypes.object,
    onItemQuantityChange: PropTypes.func,
    onAddItemToCart: PropTypes.func,
    showLoading: PropTypes.bool,
    isWishlistItem: PropTypes.bool,
    primaryAction: PropTypes.node,
    secondaryActions: PropTypes.node,
    deliveryActions: PropTypes.node,
    containerStyles: PropTypes.object,
    isRemoving: PropTypes.bool,
    pickupInStore: PropTypes.bool
}

export default ProductItem

**Directive:** resolve two open questions from the Figma-fidelity audit — (1) is the desktop price position a real gap or a disclosed decision, (2) does the real cart path ever reach `item-attributes.tsx`'s un-restyled branches. Both fully traced with primary-source citations; no guessing.

**Question 1 — CONFIRMED, inherited base-SFCC layout, not a restyle deviation.**

`node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/product-item/index.jsx` (the real, unmodified base file this was copy-first ported from), lines 65-110: the exact same shape as the shipped override — `Stack spacing={1}` groups name+attributes with price hidden behind `HideOnDesktop` (lines 66-76), then a second `Flex` row pairs the quantity picker with a `Stack` containing `HideOnMobile`-wrapped price + `primaryAction` (lines 87-110). This is byte-comparable to `overrides/app/components/product-item/index.tsx`'s current structure. The desktop price-next-to-stepper/Remove positioning already existed in base SFCC, untouched by anything Zimmermann did — commit 5's restyle changed colours/fonts/`textStyle` in place, never touched this flex/stack skeleton. `plan.md` lines 234 and 251 both explicitly scope step 2.2 to text restyling and the `item-name` spread-order bug only; neither mentions rearranging this layout.

But: `.claude/session-notes.md` §11.2 (the primary source `plan.md` itself cites) has its own explicit Desktop/Mobile comparison table, and it states plainly: `Item Info | flex-col, name above price | flex-row justify-between` (Desktop | Mobile columns) — i.e., the *intended* Figma spec wants name+price grouped together on desktop too, just as a column instead of mobile's row. Nobody's own "Changes" scope in `plan.md` ever flagged that this specific table row required restructuring the inherited base skeleton to match. So: not a code-vs-Figma value bug, and not a deliberately-disclosed decision either — it's a real gap in `plan.md`'s own scoping that never carried session-notes' own recorded desktop spec into the "Changes" list for step 2.2. Facts only; the call on whether to fix it is Marcel's.

**Question 2 — CONFIRMED, unreachable from anything this build touched, same shape as `product-quantity-picker.tsx`.**

`CartItemVariantAttributes` (`item-attributes.tsx`) has exactly 8 real call sites in the whole tree (grep, excluding tests/stories): `overrides/app/components/product-item/index.tsx:287` (this build's own override, `combineAttributeValues` present → JSX shorthand `true`) and 7 base, un-overridden SFCC files — `order-summary/index.jsx:98`, `multiship-order-summary.jsx:116`, base `product-item/index.jsx:68` (superseded by the override anyway), `confirmation/index.jsx:381`, `checkout/partials/shipping-product-cards.jsx:77`, `checkout/partials/pickup-address.jsx:75`, `account/order-detail.jsx:94` — none of which pass `combineAttributeValues`. `item-attributes.tsx:73` defaults it to `false`. So the only call site inside SFCC-11's own scope always takes the correctly-styled `styles.colourSize` branch (line 148-150, already confirmed correct against Figma); every per-key/`gray.700`/`black.600`/`green.700`-styled branch (lines 143, 155, 184-224, 237-251) is exclusively reachable through the 7 base consumers, exercising exactly the same unstyled behaviour they had before this build touched the file. `combineAttributeValues` is a new, additive, backward-compatible prop — nothing changed for them. No live gap; genuinely dead code for this build's purposes, confirmed by trace rather than assumed.
